verses.text: al hamdu lil haqqil mubiin man kawnuhu liya yabiin
halal kitaabil mustabiin maha jamiihin nihami
ahmadu rabbiyal haziim hamdan kasiiran laa yariim
musalliyan halaa kariim qaadal waraa lil munhimi
ashkuru zal harshil majiid shukran yulaaqiihi maziid
musalliman halal wahiid bikalkalii wa kaliimii
shakartuhu iz khassanii bikhidmatil maahis sanii
zaa khidmatin fil halanii lahu wa fakka walami
lahu khitaabii daahiyaa bimaa yuhibbu maadiyaa
wa qaada lii aghraadiyaa zaadan lidaaril karami
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa
yaa rabbanash kur sah-yanaa bil muntaqal muhtarami
lil mustafal lazii turaam lahu salaatun wa salaam
maham tidaahi kulla haam rumtu minal mukarrimi
salli halaa manin jahal qutbal wujuudi hiina hal
wa aalihi zawin nihal wa sahbihi wa karrimi
salli halaa man juhilaa khayra nabbiyin fuddilaa
hiina abuunan jadalaa fii tiinihi wa hazzimi
wa salliman yaa rabbiyaa halaa khitaamil anbiyaa
wal mursaliinal asfiyaa imaaminal muhazzami
wa salli yaa zan nihmati halaa rasuulir rahmati
mighlaaqi baabin niqmati sababi kulli nasami
wa salliman yaa samadii halan nabii muhammadi
wa aalihi wal hummadi wa kun lizit tarassumi
yaa zal baqaa wal qidami minnii taqabbal khidamii
wal turdi zat taqaddumi bihaa muniirul laqami
zaaka khiyaarul harabi zaaka muniilul arabi
zaaka sabiilut talabi tabiibu ahlis saqami
salli halaa baabil hudaa naa-il madaa muulin nadaa
laysil hidaa maahir radaa baabil hulaa wal karami
wa salliman halal amiin zaakal makiinu wal matiin
zaakal mujiiru wal qamiin bizas sanaa wahtarimi
zaakal wahiidu wal majiid wahwal mabbarru wal ahiid
man bis tiqaamatin yaquud ilal jinaani man hami
salli wa sallim yaa qadiir halaa siraajikal muniir
wahwal bashiiru wan naziir biniqamin wa nihami
zaakal rasuulur rahati wa zaaka rahbur rahati
wa zaaka zul fasaahati zaaka rassulul malhami
salli wa sallim sarmadaa yaa man kafaanii kamadaa
halal bahiiji ahmadaa wa liya kun binihami
lii jammilanna zaahirii wa baatinii bitaahiri
yaa maahiyan kabaa-irii bijaahihi wa lamami
yaa man ladayhi amalii hannii halal muzzammili
salli bikullil kummali maha jamiihil umami
wa sallimanna yaa badiih halal mutaahi wal mutiih
zaakal mushaffahush shafiih habiibikal mufakh-khami
salli halal mubajjali yaa man hamaa han khajali
wa hinda kamhu wa jalii wa hindahu fakh-khimi
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa khillanaa yaa hibbanaa
minnaa taqabbal kutbanaa bimustafaakas sullami
salli wa salliman halaa man qad ajaaba bibalaa
yawma alastu awwalaa qabla zawit takallumi
salli halaa khayri rasuul yaa man bihi yahbuu bisuul
fil aali was sahbil huduul wal tataqabbal qalami
hab liya kawna qalamii bushaaratal muqaddami
waktub bihi taquddumii bilaa azan aw alami
salli halaa khayri nabii qaadal waraa bil adabi
yaa man kafaanii wa dabii bijaahihi wa sallimi
huwal lazii faaqa siwaah minal baraayaa bihudaah
hatta badaa katbu sumaah fii harshikal muhazzami
wa fil jinaani was suquuf wa fil wujuuhi wal kuhuuf
wa bir rimaahi was suyuuf qalaha kulla sanami
qaadal hudaata lin nahiim bikhayri zikrihil hakiim
birabbihil baaqil qadiim subhaana man lam yanami
salli wa sallim sarmadaa halal lazii qad turidaa
bilaylatin qad wulidaa fiihaa mudiimul ma-sami
laylatu mawlidin nabii laylatu mahwir riyabi
laylatu mahwit tahabi wa tuhri zit ta-assumi
bihan najaatu wal falaah mahas suruuri wan najaah
bihar rabaahu was salaah mahan difaahin niqami
hawat khawaariqa badat hanir ruwaati sabatat
kamisli naarin utfi-at maham mihaa-i daqami
wa hayni saawatal latii qad hazumat wa jallati
lil fursi qablal millati wa suyyirat kal hadami
wa kan khidaadish shuhubi tardan li-ahlir riyabi
han samhi akhbaarin nabii wa rajahuu binadami
turida fiihaa bin nujum hanis samaawaatir rajiim
wa farra khaasiran yuliim bihizbihi zaa wakami
sataha hiina wulidaa khayru nabiyyin qad badaa
salla halayhi man hadaa fu-aadahu bil hikami
nuurun haziimun qad yaraa bihi qusuura qaysaraa
man kaana fii ummil quraa makkata khayril hurumi
ii-waanu kisran sadahaa fiihaa wa qablu rufiihaa
samkun lahu fartafahaa nahwa samal mukarrimi
hattas sariirun kasaraa li-ajli hawlinih taraa
min nuuri afdalil waraa rabbi halayhi sallimi
bahda salaatin laa tazuul bil aali was sahbil huduul
wa biya jaddidis sabiil bilaa hidan aw alami
salli wa salliman halaa man haaza mawlidan jalaa
lighayrinaa zawil qilaa wal tataqabbal khidami
mawliduhu muhazzamu mubaarakun muhtaaramu
tahziimuhu yanhatimu halaa zawit taqaddumi
tahziimuhu bis sunnati yaquudunaa lil jannati
bihiz diyaadul minnati limukhlisin muhazzimi
faman yuhazzim mawlidaa nabiyyinaa baabil hudaa
falaa yuhaasabu ghadaa fahtari man wa hazzimi
faman yuhazzim mawlidaa khayril baraayaa ahmadaa
fakashahidin shahidaa badran bighayri wa hami
fakullu man anfaqa fii mawlidihil musharrafi
maalan bighayri sarafi wa law biqadri dirhami
